items.title: Stanley Kay interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001
items.q: I took her out of the Mel Lewis-Thad Jones band, two Franks, Frank Foster and Frank Wess...

ctx.x: No, no. My first club I had was called Sam’s Jazz Upstairs. It was over on top of a restaurant on 64th Street. And that was mine. And my first attraction was Dee Dee Bridgewater, I took her out of the Mel Lewis-Thad Jones band, two Franks, Frank Foster and Frank Wess, Roland Hanna, Ben Riley and a guy that played like that, I’ll think of his name, the bass player. And I tried it for about a month and the money left me.
